item.coloph: de ltar 'pho ba ye shes rlung rta 'di/ brda ston blo gros rgyal po'i kha le ba/ thos chog rang grol khol nas rgyud byung ste/ bdag gzhan don du skyang nam ming gis bkod/ nyes 'gal mchis na mtha' bral rje la mthol lo bshags/ dge ba'i 'bras bu mtha' yas sems can rnams/ zhi khro'i lha tshogs go 'phang thob gyur cig/
